## Drills

> [!problem] Two in series (d 1)
> Two equal resistors $R$ sit in series. Find the total resistance.
^inv-s12-pass

> [!solution]- Solution
> 1. Resistances in series add: $R + R = 2R$.
> Answer: $2R$.
